description: The excellence roadmap of the organization: a maturity grid (themes, items asked as questions, one description per level) assessed site by site. Returns the grid, and for each site its level and target per item, the initiative linked to an item, the assessments, and "findings": what is missing (a site due for an assessment, an item under its target with no initiative or with a closed one, a score with no evidence). Signal the findings; people decide. A site is a matrix: pass matrix_id to read one site only, in the language that site works in (one grid is kept in several languages; every site is assessed on the same items). With several roadmaps, pass roadmap_id (the error lists them).

lang.description: Language of the grid texts (en, fr, es, pt, de…). One grid, several languages: a text not translated comes in the source language. Without it: the language of the site given, else the source language. "languages" in the answer lists what exists.

matrix_id.description: UUID of a site (a matrix, from list_matrices): only that site, in its own language

roadmap_id.description: UUID of the roadmap; optional when the organization has one

name: get_excellence_roadmap
title: Get excellence roadmap
